summary: Sprint 1 shell testing complete. Backend health endpoint verified with pytest (2/2 pass). Frontend routes, bilingual toggle (ID/EN), placeholder pages with breadcrumbs, coming-soon messages, admin redirect, login placeholder, and 404 all working correctly. All required data-testid attributes present.

issues: Breadcrumb text on nested pages (e.g. 'BerandaKatalogBatu Mulia') has no visible separators between segments — likely a spacing/separator CSS gap. Minor design polish item, not a blocker.

action_items: (Optional polish) Add visible separators or spacing between breadcrumb segments in PlaceholderPage/breadcrumb component.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'); consider FastAPI lifespan handler in a later sprint.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec — browsers will reject credentialed requests. Fix before adding auth in future sprints.
No health endpoint file was directly verified but router import works and endpoint returns expected payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 1 shell is stable. All TEST_IDS in /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds.ts are wired correctly. Default language is Indonesian; language switching persists across routes via LanguageContext. Health endpoint at /api/health. When Sprint 2 adds DB/auth, revisit CORS_ORIGINS='*' + allow_credentials=True combination.
